text: K-Way is a French premium outerwear brand of BasicNet SpA, a company led by the Boglione family; in October 2024 Permira entered into an agreement to acquire a significant minority stake in K-Way from BasicNet.
short: K-Way is a BasicNet S.p.A. brand.

source.name: Permira: Permira Announces Strategic Investment in K-Way
source.quote: acquire a significant minority stake in K-Way, the renowned French premium outerwear brand, from BasicNet SpA, led by the Boglione family.
